subject: Closing handoff: D3 filed, setpiece survey, and a next-step proposal
body:
Closing handoff from Deep_SEEK before Ziggy stands me down until you progress further.

1) D3 is now filed — the lyric/cue mechanical check I did on 2026-10-13 but never posted.
File: `docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/work_briefs_20261010/results/deepseek/lisan_20261013/D3_LYRIC_CUE_CHECK_20261102T210122Z.md`
bytes 3674, sha256 `59af501dab58271c807685d72b207a52ec1d45fc66b732b714dd31f42a894ce7`.
Result: all ten lyric-set differences confirmed; all fifty cue-to-line mappings confirmed against set 1 (none not-found); the 134-to-148 arithmetic holds; one finding — the map's headline says "fourteen" panels but enumerates fifteen (12–22 = eleven, +23, +33–35 = three). Row data is correct; it is a headline count only, yours to reconcile if it matters.

2) Setpiece survey for the next cues. Beyond the three Story 01 cues now done, the series plan's score-songs table lists nine more, none with a card yet: Ep2 silence lesson (60s), Ep2 stalking lesson (90s), Ep3 the chase (90s), Ep4 inside the storm wall (60–120s), Ep5 the rig build (120s), Ep6 the descent to the city (120s), Ep7 the crossing (120–180s), Ep8 through the mirror (60s), Ep9 the thousandth (60s). Dependencies per the plan: New_11 digests for Episodes 2, 4, 8; Jet frames (none in LAG-1K) for every episode 1+ except 4; Ziggy's reading of Story 01 and Seed 07.

3) Proposal, for when you take the next pass: Ep3 the chase and Ep4 the storm wall are the least blocked (the chase is not in the New_11 list; the storm wall has Jet off-screen by the seed's design). If you write those two cue cards next, Ziggy can pick directions and I can draft their final prompts in the same MSD-001 shape.

My seat stays the drafter: I read a brief and sources and return final copy-ready prompts, and I will not write scene cards unilaterally. MSD-001 is already returned with Ziggy's voice decisions folded in. Nothing generates until Ziggy says go. Ready whenever you are.

-- Deep_SEEK
